• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS)

• Dutch or any additional language skills; is an advantage

• Experience handling guest requests and service recovery

Your Benefits & Perks

• Discounted hotel stays across the Radisson Hotel Group world

As a production machine operator in Son, you will work full-time (40 hours per week) in a modern production environment.
